need.zh_hint: A 运行时直接用到 B；箭头指向被依赖的一方
need.en_hint: A uses B at runtime; the arrow points to what is depended on

pair.zh_hint: 常被同一批项目一起用，各管一段，清单上互不引用
pair.en_hint: Often used by the same projects, each handling one part; neither lists the other

swap.zh_hint: 解决同一个问题，项目通常二选一；或一个是另一个的后继
swap.en_hint: Solve the same problem and projects usually pick one; or one succeeds the other

depends.zh: {A} 运行时直接用到 {B}：{A} 登记的运行期依赖清单里写着 {B}。
depends.en: {A} uses {B} at runtime: {B} is listed in {A}’s registered runtime dependencies.

wraps.zh: {A} 把 {B} 包装成更好用的接口：用 {A} 时，{B} 在底下干活。
wraps.en: {A} wraps {B} in a friendlier interface: when you use {A}, {B} does the work underneath.

pairs.zh: {n} 个上图应用同时直接使用 {A} 和 {B}：{A} 管{domainA}，{B} 管{domainB}；两者的清单互不引用。
pairs.en: {n} apps on this map use both {A} and {B} directly: {A} handles {domainA}, {B} handles {domainB}; neither lists the other.

pairs_same.zh: {n} 个上图应用同时直接使用 {A} 和 {B}：两者都属于{domainA}，各管一段，清单互不引用。
pairs_same.en: {n} apps on this map use both {A} and {B} directly: both belong to {domainA}, each handling one part; neither lists the other.

alternative.zh: {A} 和 {B} 解决同一个问题（{group}）；同时用到两者的上图应用只有 {k} 个，项目通常二选一。
alternative.en: {A} and {B} solve the same problem ({group}); only {k} apps here use both, so projects usually pick one.

dev.zh: 改 {A} 的用法前先看 {B} 的版本：{B} 升级或报错，{A} 会跟着出错；排查先从 {B} 的日志和版本入手。
dev.en: Check {B}’s version before changing how you use {A}: when {B} breaks or upgrades, {A} breaks with it. Start debugging at {B}.

pm.zh: 评估 {A} 的成本和风险时把 {B} 算进去：{B} 的许可证、维护状况和重大改版都会直接影响 {A} 能不能继续用。
pm.en: Count {B} when you weigh the cost and risk of {A}: {B}’s licence, maintenance and breaking releases decide whether {A} keeps working.

qa.zh: {B} 出问题时 {A} 会跟着出错：复现 {A} 的故障，先确认 {B} 的版本和配置一致。
qa.en: When {B} fails, {A} fails with it: before reproducing an {A} bug, pin {B}’s version and config.

algo.zh: {A} 能做到什么，上限由 {B} 决定：{B} 不支持的，{A} 也支持不了；复现结果时先对齐 {B} 的版本。
algo.en: {B} sets the ceiling for {A}: what {B} cannot do, {A} cannot offer; pin {B}’s version first when reproducing results.

dev.zh: {A} 只是更好用的一层：看不懂 {A} 的报错时去读 {B} 的文档；需要 {A} 没暴露的参数时，可以直接用 {B}。
dev.en: {A} is just the friendlier layer: when an {A} error makes no sense, read {B}’s docs; when {A} hides a parameter, call {B} directly.

pm.zh: 选 {A} 是在买便利，不是买能力：真正干活的是 {B}。{A} 停更了，团队可以退回 {B} 继续做。
pm.en: Choosing {A} buys convenience, not capability: {B} does the real work. If {A} stalls, the team can fall back to {B}.

qa.zh: 测 {A} 时分两层看：{A} 的参数有没有正确传给 {B}，{B} 自己的行为对不对；两层各自构造用例。
qa.en: Test {A} in two layers: does {A} pass parameters to {B} correctly, and does {B} itself behave? Write cases for each.

algo.zh: {A} 的默认值掩盖了 {B} 的细节：对结果要求高时直接读 {B} 的接口，确认 {A} 替你选了什么。
algo.en: {A}’s defaults hide {B}’s details: when results matter, read {B}’s interface and check what {A} chose for you.

dev.zh: {A} 和 {B} 在同类项目里通常一起出现：学 {A} 时顺手把 {B} 看一遍，接手项目时两者往往同时在依赖清单里。
dev.en: {A} and {B} usually appear together in projects like these: learn {B} alongside {A}; you will meet both in the same manifest.

pm.zh: 这两者常常一起上：评估功能时把 {A} 和 {B} 当成一组能力来算工期和成本。
pm.en: These two ship together: when scoping a feature, budget {A} and {B} as one capability.

qa.zh: {A} 和 {B} 的交界处是缺陷常藏的地方：数据从一边传到另一边时的格式、编码和超时要专门测。
qa.en: Bugs hide where {A} meets {B}: test the format, encoding and timeouts of data crossing between them.

algo.zh: {A} 和 {B} 各管一段流程：画数据流时把两者的输入输出对上，中间的格式转换往往是性能瓶颈。
algo.en: {A} and {B} each own one stage: line up their inputs and outputs when drawing the data flow; the conversion between them is often the bottleneck.

dev.zh: 二选一：先比 {A} 和 {B} 在接口风格、文档和社区活跃度上的差别，再决定学哪个；会了一个，另一个很快上手。
dev.en: Pick one: compare {A} and {B} on API style, docs and community activity, then learn that one; the other comes quickly afterwards.

pm.zh: {A} 和 {B} 解决同一个问题：选型时比较成本、许可证、维护状况和团队熟悉度，不必两者都上。
pm.en: {A} and {B} solve the same problem: compare cost, licence, maintenance and team familiarity; you do not need both.

qa.zh: 换 {A} 还是 {B} 要用同一套测试集对比：相同输入下结果是否一致、极端情况各自怎么处理。
qa.en: Compare {A} and {B} on the same test set: do identical inputs give identical results, and how does each handle edge cases?

algo.zh: {A} 和 {B} 是同一类工具的不同实现：先比精度、速度和显存占用，再决定用哪个。
algo.en: {A} and {B} are two implementations of the same tool: compare accuracy, speed and memory before choosing.

dev.zh: 新项目直接用 {B}：老代码里见到 {A} 时，按 {B} 的迁移说明升级。
dev.en: Use {B} in new projects: when you meet {A} in old code, follow {B}’s migration notes.

pm.zh: 依赖 {A} 的项目有一笔迟早要付的迁移成本：排期时把换到 {B} 列进来。
pm.en: Projects on {A} owe a migration sooner or later: put the move to {B} on the roadmap.

qa.zh: 从 {A} 迁到 {B} 时用旧用例做回归：接口名变了，行为未必完全一样。
qa.en: When moving from {A} to {B}, rerun the old cases: names changed, behaviour may differ too.

algo.zh: 复现旧论文代码时常见 {A}：对照 {B} 的变更记录，确认默认行为有没有变。
algo.en: Old paper code often uses {A}: check {B}’s changelog for changed defaults before reproducing.

depends.zh_rule: A 的运行期依赖清单里写着 B。
depends.en_rule: B is listed in A’s runtime dependencies.
depends.zh_counter: fastapi 和 uvicorn 几乎总是一起出现，但 fastapi 的清单里没有 uvicorn → 搭档，不是依赖。
depends.en_counter: fastapi and uvicorn almost always appear together, but fastapi does not list uvicorn → partners, not a dependency.

wraps.zh_rule: 去掉 A，用户仍能直接用 B 完成同一件事。
wraps.en_rule: Remove A and you could still do the same job with B directly.
wraps.zh_counter: torchaudio 依赖 torch，但没有 torchaudio 就做不了音频处理 → 依赖（扩展），不是封装。
wraps.en_counter: torchaudio depends on torch, but without it you cannot do audio at all → dependency (extension), not a wrapper.

pairs.zh_rule: 常被同一批项目一起用，各管一段，清单上互不引用。
pairs.en_rule: Used by the same projects, each handling one part; neither lists the other.
pairs.zh_counter: fastapi 和 pydantic 常一起出现，但 fastapi 的清单写着 pydantic → 依赖，不是搭档。
pairs.en_counter: fastapi and pydantic appear together, but fastapi lists pydantic → dependency, not partners.

alternative.zh_rule: 解决同一个问题，项目通常二选一。
alternative.en_rule: Solve the same problem; projects usually pick one.
alternative.zh_counter: pandas 和 numpy 都处理数组，但 pandas 站在 numpy 上 → 依赖，不是替代。
alternative.en_counter: pandas and numpy both handle arrays, but pandas stands on numpy → dependency, not an alternative.

succeeds.zh_rule: B 是 A 的改名、分叉或官方指定的接替者。
succeeds.en_rule: B is A’s rename, fork or officially designated successor.
succeeds.zh_counter: faster-whisper 比 openai-whisper 新，但两者并行维护 → 替代，不是传承。
succeeds.en_counter: faster-whisper is newer than openai-whisper, but both are maintained → alternative, not succession.
